title: Laugh Clip
features:
Laugh Clip for mobile
Remove the first 5 lines if you want to use it on PC
Pretty simple UI with everything to do it easily

Quick Tut:
Hug the wall (1.1 Studs Max), look in the opposite direction your character is facing, then click the Laugh button. Once your head is far enough back, hit "Lag" and enable Shiftlock.

function SetLag(Button: Instance, Time: Number)
LagTime = Time

for v, k in next, {B25, B50, B75, B100} do
k.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 48) end
Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(94, 86, 213) end

SetLag(B50, .5)

B25.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
SetLag(B25, .25) end)

B50.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
SetLag(B50, .5) end)

B75.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
SetLag(B75, .75) end)

B100.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
SetLag(B100, 1) end)

Laugh.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
Character.Animate.PlayEmote:Invoke'laugh' end)

LagButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
EndTime = os.clock() + LagTime
repeat
until os.clock() >= EndTime end)
